title.description: Write the document's title exactly as the document has it.

point.description: Write the key point in one sentence.

source.description: Write the address of the paragraph the point comes from (report.sections[].paragraphs, for example fs://pdf/001#3.2) or of a table.

quote.description: Copy the sentence of that paragraph (or table) that shows the point, word for word.

tables.description: Choose 0 to 2 tables to put on the summary page, only the most important ones. An empty list when there is no table or no useful one.

source.description: Write the chosen table's address exactly as the report has it (report.tables[].address).

line.description: Write in one sentence what the table shows.

rows.description: The numbers of the rows to show (1 is the header row at the top, and it is always shown). Empty shows every row. For a table with more than 14 rows, write only the numbers of the most important rows.

figures.description: Choose 0 to 2 figures to put on the summary page, only the most important ones. An empty list when there is no figure.

figure.description: Write the chosen figure's address exactly as the report has it (report.figures[].address).

line.description: Write in one sentence what the figure shows. Write only what its caption and the text near it say.

conclusion.description: Write the document's conclusion in one or two sentences.
